baselines.title: Dense synthetic alias reference lifecycle
baselines.purpose: Bounded single-arm CPU/offline reference for training, validation, capability, generation, resource, and static-report lifecycle; not a useful-chat or architecture-quality claim.

profile.note: existing 64×2 dense chat-recall configuration, FFN 192, extended fixed acquisition budget; not the generic smoke profile

capability_expectations.expectation: At least 12/24 full-answer correct under the frozen training-seen retention card.
Record every held-out wording case; no minimum score is required for lifecycle validity.
Record every context-override case; no minimum score is required for lifecycle validity.

limitations: One CPU seed and finite synthetic offline chat-recall data do not establish independent replication or useful general chat.
The baseline is a lifecycle and acquisition reference, not evidence of a memory, attention, FFN, efficiency, or quality advantage.
The fixed 1536-step limit bound this run at step 1536 with 391424 of the 393216-token ceiling observed.
Static report validation preserves archival evidence but does not make omitted checkpoint binaries locally runnable.
The sole seed's held-out validation loss rose from 6.176402 to 7.056087; the required validation gate failed, so the candidate was not promoted. No retry was run.
Acquisition retention was 24/24; held-out recall was 8/12 and context override 0/8. These finite synthetic outcomes do not establish independent or general capability.

next_test.action: Test narrower-FFN compensation on an independently authored compositional task population; retain the existing controls and all card outcomes before considering a wider run.
next_test.design_change: Replace the finite chat-recall task population with a separately frozen compositional train/dev/card corpus; the historical same-seed rerun is not an independent replication.

blockers.description: The current reports use a finite synthetic alias/recall curriculum and do not establish composition or independent-task generalization.
blockers.resolution: Freeze and hash a new independent train/dev/card corpus and scorer before any outcome-based setting changes.

next_test.action: Run a frozen no-memory/final-injection/embedding-injection comparison focused on untouched context overrides, with seed-matched configuration and held-out reports.
next_test.design_change: The historical context study varied memory condition and budget but did not vary the cataloged injection-placement axis; preregister placement as the changed field.

blockers.description: The accepted context-override study is relevant historical Engram evidence but does not directly compare injection placement.
blockers.resolution: Freeze no-memory, final, and embedding placement arms with matched training conditions and the existing held-out override distinction.

next_test.action: Preregister an independent held-out wording family and repeat only under the sealed source/recipient controls; do not tune against the reported final-state failure.
next_test.design_change: Use a separately authored recipient-held-out wording family and retain the current final-state wording as a non-tuned reference; the existing supportive criterion failed and representation portability was not tested.

blockers.description: Adapter gains were wording-specific: the supportive six-group criterion failed narrowly and the second final wording remained at chance.
blockers.resolution: Freeze an independent recipient-held-out wording family and its score rule before another campaign.

next_test.action: Extend the negative two-case comparison to multiple recipient configurations and held-out cases, retaining baseline, random, frozen-only, and trained-adapter controls.
next_test.design_change: Expand the held-out denominator and recipient configurations; do not change the reported two-case result or claim general transfer from it.

blockers.description: The documented two-case adapter result is negative and too narrow to establish general transfer.
blockers.resolution: Freeze a multi-recipient held-out protocol with exact source-table identity and unchanged frozen-table controls.

next_test.action: Complete the predeclared ownership-profile and neural-weight curve; retain every checkpoint and separate token, target, and weighted-supervision counters.
next_test.design_change: Move from one iso-total coordinate to the fully declared 75-coordinate curve without selecting an optimum from the smoke observation.

blockers.description: Only iso-total/s17/n50/w50 is described as executed; the 75-coordinate scaffold remains incomplete.
blockers.resolution: Execute and validate every frozen coordinate or retain explicit partial/blocked status for each omitted coordinate.

next_test.action: Run a behavior-focused matched MLA-latent-width and memory matrix; keep held-out loss and every capability-card category separate from report-pipeline validation.
next_test.design_change: Replace the engineering-only smoke endpoint with a preregistered behavior evaluation; do not reinterpret mixed interactions or zero cards as an MLA quality conclusion.

blockers.description: The 12-run CPU/offline exercise validated analysis paths only and reported 36 zero card scores.
blockers.resolution: Freeze and execute the behavior-focused matrix while retaining all seeds, declared contrasts, and card categories.

next_test.action: Run the declared dense/block-sparse and memory/no-memory contrasts; report task outcomes and synchronized end-to-end measurements separately from attention-component timing.
Run the declared dense-2x/dense-4x/MoE and memory/no-memory smoke matrix; retain separate LM, card, and routing diagnostics.
Run the declared no/small/large/huge lexical-table smoke sweep and report table bytes, LM loss, and each card separately.

tested_conditions: CPU/PyTorch FP32, smoke/offline, 18 runs across three seeds and three FFN widths; every run reached 32 updates / 4096 tokens.
findings.observation: All 18 runs scored zero on each of the three capability cards. Lexical-memory held-out loss deltas were lower at 4x and 2x FFN width but mixed at 1x; this smoke showed no consistent held-out-loss benefit.
supported_claims: Lookup did not demonstrate capability-card compensation for narrower FFN width at this smoke endpoint.
The measured held-out-loss direction varied with FFN width under this finite offline task.
unsupported_claims: This does not establish general model quality, long-training outcomes, or behavior on other task populations.
It does not establish speed, efficiency, statistical significance, or a universal FFN replacement claim.
findings.rationale: The verified report records all declared outcomes, but all cards were zero and the bounded validation-loss effects do not support a general compensation claim.
findings.next_action: Reopen only with an independently frozen compositional task population and unchanged outcome reporting.
reopen_conditions: A separately authored compositional train/dev/card corpus and scorer are frozen before training.

tested_conditions: CPU/PyTorch FP32, nano/offline, 18 runs across three seeds and three FFN widths; all runs reached 128 updates / 32640 tokens.
findings.observation: At 1x FFN width, lexical memory had higher held-out validation loss in all three seed pairs; all 18 runs scored zero on each capability card. The report found no consistent same-width held-out-loss improvement.
supported_claims: The nano protocol provides no evidence that lookup compensated for a narrower FFN at the measured endpoint.
The 1x lexical-memory loss delta was positive for all three recorded seeds.
unsupported_claims: Three seeds on finite offline chat-recall do not establish behavior on independent compositional tasks.
This does not establish a general negative result for longer training or other model/data scales.
findings.rationale: This is the closest existing scale evidence, but zero card outcomes and narrow synthetic data limit the interpretation.
findings.next_action: Use only as a prior; any new task population must be frozen independently.
reopen_conditions: A separately authored compositional train/dev/card corpus and scorer are frozen before training.

tested_conditions: CPU/PyTorch FP32; same nano study, matrix, data-profile, and scale identities; new run IDs, same coordinate seeds.
findings.observation: The repeated execution reproduced prior held-out validation loss at all 18 coordinates exactly; it adds no independent-seed evidence.
supported_claims: The recorded nano metric was reproducible for this same-seed execution under identical inputs.
unsupported_claims: A same-seed rerun is not an independent replication and does not increase the number of independent seeds.
findings.rationale: Retain reproducibility evidence without treating duplicate seed coordinates as new scientific support.
findings.next_action: Do not count this report as independent replication; reopen only under a new task population or seed plan.
reopen_conditions: An independent seed or independently frozen task population is available.

tested_conditions: Accepted CPU/PyTorch study with three seeds, two exact-target budgets, 24 completed endpoints, and 72 preregistered card evaluations.
findings.observation: Untouched context-override outcomes were 0/8 at every one of the 24 endpoints. Training-seen acquisition varied, but did not establish held-out override acquisition. The study varied memory condition and budget; it did not compare injection placement.
supported_claims: The accepted study found no untouched override acquisition under its frozen protocol.
The result is relevant historical Engram evidence but is not a placement-axis comparison.
unsupported_claims: This does not establish that embedding and final injection are equivalent or ineffective.
It does not establish general chat quality, significance, or an Engram advantage.
findings.rationale: The acceptance record verifies completed endpoints and response scoring; the current catalog placement question remains untested.
findings.next_action: Test placement directly with frozen no-memory, final-injection, and embedding-injection arms.
reopen_conditions: A matched placement factorial with untouched held-out override cases is preregistered.

tested_conditions: Documented CPU iso-total/s17/n50/w50 smoke; 32 updates and five observed checkpoints; one of 75 scaffolded coordinates.
findings.observation: All recorded acquisition, development, and frozen card scores were zero at each checkpoint; validation loss was nonmonotonic. The full 75-coordinate sweep was not executed.
supported_claims: This one documented coordinate did not establish an ownership optimum or capability-card success.
The available notes report no FLOP, latency, energy, or saved-token measurements.
unsupported_claims: The source note is not a validated report bundle and cannot support a measured replication gate.
One coordinate cannot establish allocation-dependent retention or a full curve.
findings.rationale: The one-coordinate smoke is an explicit partial observation; its source note is not sufficient to promote a scientific curve claim.
findings.next_action: Complete the frozen ownership curve and preserve missing or blocked coordinates.
reopen_conditions: All 75 planned coordinates are executed or individually retained as partial/blocked with reasons.

tested_conditions: Documented two-case held-out byte-addressed portable-adapter comparison against baseline and random frozen-table controls.
findings.observation: Baseline, random frozen-table, and trained portable-adapter runs each had zero exact matches and reciprocal rank 0.75. Mean expected-value log probability was -5.0596, -4.9939, and -5.1395 respectively; the trained adapter did not outperform random under this protocol.
supported_claims: The documented two-case comparison did not demonstrate adapter benefit over its random-table control.
unsupported_claims: Two cases do not establish general transfer failure or success across recipient configurations.
The documentation is not a static report bundle or independent multi-recipient validation.
findings.rationale: The reported adapter result is negative against the random-table control, and the sample is too small for a broader portability conclusion.
findings.next_action: Extend the held-out denominator and recipient configurations without changing the archived result.
reopen_conditions: A preregistered multi-recipient protocol with additional held-out cases and matched frozen controls is available.

tested_conditions: Sealed CPU nano N=2048 protocol; three source seeds; six recipient width/seed groups; 54 completed coordinates, 42 trained and 12 observation-only.
findings.observation: All source gates passed and the same learned table bytes were verified across recipient widths. Real adapters averaged 71.70% on one held-out wording, but the preregistered all-six-group >=0.50 criterion failed narrowly at width64/seed73; all six adapters scored 3.125% on the second final wording. Representation portability was not tested.
supported_claims: The report verifies source acquisition and byte-exact artifact reuse under the sealed protocol.
Recipient-local calibration improved one held-out wording on average but did not satisfy the supportive criterion or generalize to the second final wording.
unsupported_claims: This does not establish robust wording transfer, ordinary-language quality, or representation portability.
The single bounded synthetic task does not establish general transfer to other architectures or domains.
findings.rationale: The verified report separates successful source/artifact gates from the failed supportive adapter criterion and wording-specific outcomes.
findings.next_action: Reopen only with an independent wording family frozen before training; do not tune to the second-wording failure.
reopen_conditions: An independent held-out wording suite and score rule are frozen before a new campaign.

tested_conditions: Documented CPU/offline analysis smoke; 12 runs across dense/MLA-half, memory absent/present, and three seeds; 32 updates per run.
findings.observation: All 36 capability-card scores were zero and the three-seed validation-loss interaction signs were mixed. The exercise validated report-analysis paths; it did not test an attention or memory quality claim.
supported_claims: The documented smoke exercised factorial, nondominance, allocation, and boundary-sweep report paths.
unsupported_claims: This does not establish MLA/memory benefit, a synergy statistic, speed, or paper-equivalent cache compression.
The document is not a verified static report bundle for this study.
findings.rationale: Retain the engineering validation separately from behavioral conclusions.
findings.next_action: Run a behavior-focused matched matrix with frozen endpoints and all capability categories.
reopen_conditions: A behavior-focused protocol and matched matrix are frozen before training.
